fire: Two square roots can be combined only if they have the same radicand.

Surds with different roots must be rewritten before they are added.
Only terms with the same variable part can be collected together.
When two roots have the same index, you may multiply their radicands.
Exponents with different bases cannot be combined this way.
quiet: Two brothers can share a room only if they have the same bedtime.
You cannot mix paints with different finishes on one wall.
To find the average of two numbers, add them and halve the sum.
Each team plays the same opponent twice in a season.
The two maps use different colours for the rivers.
Write the equation, then solve it for the unknown value.
When two shops open at the same hour, the street gets busy.
Plot the points on the grid and join them with a line.
